onset.Description: Seconds from the first sample of the LFP recording: source NWB time minus the LFP starting_time (0.00248475 s). All NWB times share the session clock.

duration.Description: stop_time - start_time of the source interval row; 0 for point events.

Levels.sternberg_trial: One row of the NWB table intervals/trials ("Intervals for the Sternberg Task").
Levels.ttl: TTL marker from acquisition/events (code in value).
Levels.experiment_id: Marker from acquisition/experiment_ids (only when not aligned with TTLs).
Levels.stimulus_presentation: Picture presentation from stimulus/presentation/StimulusPresentation (IndexSeries; stimulus_index indexes the source StimulusTemplates).

value.Description: TTL code. Source description: The events coorespond to the TTL markers for each trial. The TTL markers are the following: 61 = Start of Experiment, 11 = Fixation Cross, 1 = Picture #1 Shown, 2 = Picture #2 Shown, 3 = Picture #3 Shown, 5 = Transition between each picture presentation, 6 = End of Encoding Sequence / Start of Maintenance Period, 7 = Probe Stimulus, 8 = Subject Response, 60 = End of Experiment

stimulus_index.Description: Index into the source StimulusTemplates image list (images not distributed here).

source_table.Description: NWB TimeIntervals table the row comes from.

source_row_id.Description: Row id in that NWB table.

source_start_time.Description: Original NWB time (start_time or timestamp) in the session clock.

PicIDs_Encoding1.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: Picture ID for Enc1 loads.

PicIDs_Encoding2.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: Picture ID for Enc2 loads.

PicIDs_Encoding3.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: Picture ID for Enc1 loads.

PicIDs_Probe.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: Picture ID for Probe loads.

loads.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: Encoding loads for each trial

probe_in_out.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: Whether the probe image was held (1) or not held (0) in memory.

response_accuracy.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: Whether the subject response was correct (1) or incorrect (0).

timestamps_Encoding1.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: Start times of picture #1 presentation. Times are absolute NWB session-clock seconds (subtract the LFP starting_time to get recording time).

timestamps_Encoding1_end.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: End times of picture #1 presentation. Times are absolute NWB session-clock seconds (subtract the LFP starting_time to get recording time).

timestamps_Encoding2.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: Start times of picture #2 presentation. Times are absolute NWB session-clock seconds (subtract the LFP starting_time to get recording time).

timestamps_Encoding2_end.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: End times of picture #2 presentation. Times are absolute NWB session-clock seconds (subtract the LFP starting_time to get recording time).

timestamps_Encoding3.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: Start times of picture #3 presentation. Times are absolute NWB session-clock seconds (subtract the LFP starting_time to get recording time).

timestamps_Encoding3_end.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: End times of picture #3 presentation. Times are absolute NWB session-clock seconds (subtract the LFP starting_time to get recording time).

timestamps_FixationCross.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: Start times of fixation cross. Times are absolute NWB session-clock seconds (subtract the LFP starting_time to get recording time).

timestamps_Maintenance.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: Start times of maintenance periods. Times are absolute NWB session-clock seconds (subtract the LFP starting_time to get recording time).

timestamps_Probe.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: Start times of probe onset. Times are absolute NWB session-clock seconds (subtract the LFP starting_time to get recording time).

timestamps_Response.Description: Source NWB column copied verbatim. Source description: Time stamps of button press. Times are absolute NWB session-clock seconds (subtract the LFP starting_time to get recording time).
